title: Workout plan, version 1
description: A reusable workout routine: an ordered list of exercise prescriptions. A prescription says what is PLANNED; performed sets are logged separately and are never created by importing a plan. Omit a field to mean 'not prescribed'. A plan may carry an optional fixed schedule (fixed weekdays, or a weekly frequency); a schedule says when the plan is meant to be done and never creates or changes a workout.

name.description: Identifies the plan. Import matches existing plans by name, case-insensitively.

schedule.description: Optional. When the plan is meant to be done, in the server's configured timezone (weeks start on the server's configured day, Sunday by default). Omit for an unscheduled plan. On import with on_conflict=replace, a document without `schedule` clears the existing plan's schedule.

days.description: Lower-case three-letter days. The server also accepts full names and any case, and stores them canonically in Monday-first order.

times_per_week.description: How many workouts per week (the server's configured week, Sunday-Saturday by default); the days are up to you.

items.description: Performed in this order. Each exercise may appear once; use `sets` for volume.

exercise.description: Exercise name or alias. Normalized to lower case with collapsed whitespace. Unknown names create a new exercise.

rep_min.description: Lower end of the rep range. For a fixed target set rep_min = rep_max.

rep_max.description: Upper end of the rep range. Must be >= rep_min when both are given.

target_rpe.description: Optional target rate of perceived exertion.

superset.description: Items sharing a label are performed back to back.
